gaps.name: phase-done accepts a non-regular REQUIREMENTS.md - the regular-file bar the gate set for CHANGELOG.md never reached the sibling seam
gaps.reason: behavior wrong - cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:700-702 decides 'unreadable' from `read()` returning null, i.e. from whether reading THREW, which is the exact defect the blocking risk_surface review found in readChangelog and gate commit a90d8b12 fixed one seam over with `statSync(file).isFile()`. A path that is not a regular file is either never classified (it reads cleanly) or never reached (it blocks).
gaps.evidence: cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs:700-702 has no statSync/isFile check, against cadence-core/bin/release-bump.mjs:212 which does. Measured against the real binary at HEAD, 2026-08-22, n=1 each: (a) FIFO at .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md - `timeout 6 node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs phase-done --n 1 --dir <fx>` exited 124 having printed nothing; the seam hangs before its own refusal can run, so the advertised halt never arrives (ROADMAP.md sha256 unchanged - nothing torn, but no envelope either). (b) symlink to /dev/null at .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md - the run printed {"ok":true,"roadmap":{"line":9,"now":"[x]"},"reqs":[],"wrote":["ROADMAP.md","REQUIREMENTS.md"]} at exit 0 and replaced the symlink with a 0-byte regular file, having read '' as a genuine requirements document. SUMMARY.md's open item names root cause and the FIFO symptom; the clean-read symptom (a silent write plus an envelope claiming REQUIREMENTS.md moved) is not disclosed anywhere and is the closer analogue of the changelog defect the gate rejected.
gaps.missing: In cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs's three-state REQUIREMENTS.md read (around :700-702), classify a present path that is not a regular file as UNREADABLE before reading it, mirroring readChangelog at cadence-core/bin/release-bump.mjs:212 (`try { if (!statSync(reqFile).isFile()) -> unreadable } catch { -> unreadable }`), so both shapes reach the existing `unreadable-requirements` pre-flight refusal. Add one regression case beside planning.test.mjs:907 using `symlinkSync('/dev/null', ...)` guarded by existsSync('/dev/null') - the same uid-independent idiom release-bump.test.mjs:315-345 already ships, no chmodSync. All seven declared acceptance criteria pass without this; it is the one proven residual.
